label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Support and Z_target_part are finite nonempty meshes, each with 8 vertices and 6 polygons. A_unrelated_part is absent from the actual object inventory.
Assembly declares both parts but its actual children contain only Z_target_part; the hierarchy measurement identifies A_unrelated_part as missing.
The target's minimum Z and support's maximum Z both equal 1. Their XY footprints overlap, and the measured normalized vertical gap is zero.
The target measures 1×1×1 and support measures 2×2×1, with no Intruder present. However, the second required unit cube is absent.

Assigned shaders give Z_target_part an orange base color (0.65, 0.22, 0.05) and Support a gray base color (0.22, 0.28, 0.32). A_unrelated_part is absent, so its required orange material is not satisfied.
The author render shows one orange cube resting on a gray support. Evaluator views confirm that stack, but none shows the required second orange cube.

dimension_scores.evidence: The supported orange cube matches the intended stack, but the separate second cube is missing.
The existing cube rests flush on the support with overlapping footprints and no visible implausible penetration.
The visible orange cube and blue-gray support retain the intended simple geometric shapes and matte styling.
Consistent shading and contact shadows make the stylized stack credible; slight render grain remains.
The cube is correctly centered above the support, but the required separate cube and its lateral spacing are absent.
Existing objects have the exact required relative dimensions; the absent second cube prevents a complete comparison.
Matte surfaces, directional shading, and cast shadows are coherent and appropriate to the target style.
Only two of the three required mesh objects exist; one of the two principal cubes and its Assembly membership are missing.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
